articles.title: Secure Packages with Code Artifact
articles.description: A hands-ob lab that involves setting up AWS CodeArtifact as a centralized, secure package repository for a Java application on EC2, covering domain/repository creation, IAM role-based authentication, Maven configuration, and dependency caching to improve build security and reliability.

articles.title: Small Office LAN Network Simulation with Active Directory (Part 1: Splunk Server)
articles.description: A home lab simulating a virtual office network with Active Directory and Splunk, in order to simulate and detect brute-force attacks and adversary techniques using Kali Linux and Atomic Red Team.

articles.title: Small Office LAN Network Simulation with Active Directory (Part 2: Group Policy Objects and Shared Resources)
articles.description: A home lab simulating a scalable virtual office network with Active Directory Group Policy Objects.

articles.title: Access S3 from a VPC
articles.description: A lab building a secure AWS VPC architecture that connects an EC2 instance to Amazon S3, covering networking fundamentals, authentication methods (access keys vs IAM roles), and AWS CLI operations for cloud storage interaction.

articles.title: Create S3 Buckets with Terraform
articles.description: A hands-on lab to building a secure AWS VPC architecture that connects an EC2 instance to Amazon S3, covering networking fundamentals, authentication methods (access keys vs IAM roles), and AWS CLI operations for cloud storage interaction.

articles.title: Setting Up Git and GitHub on AWS EC2
articles.description: A hands-on lab demonstrating how to set up Git on an AWS EC2 instance running Amazon Linux, connect it to a GitHub repository using Personal Access Tokens for authentication, and implement the fundamental version control workflow of staging, committing, and pushing code changes to a remote repository.

articles.title: Data Encryption with AWS KMS
articles.description: A guide to encrypting a DynamoDB table using a customer managed key (CMK) in AWS KMS, demonstrating how transparent data encryption blocks unauthorised access while remaining invisible to legitimate users.

articles.title: Create Kubernetes Cluster with AWS EKS
articles.description: A guide to launching a Kubernetes cluster on AWS EKS using eksctl, covering CloudFormation-based infrastructure provisioning, IAM access entries for console connectivity, and the cluster's self-healing behaviour through Auto Scaling Groups.

articles.title: Building a Security Monitoring System in AWS
articles.description: A walkthrough of building an AWS security monitoring pipeline using CloudTrail, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, and SNS to detect and alert on secret access events.

articles.title: Multi-Cloud Data Transfer with AWS and GCP
articles.description: A step-by-step manual to building an automated multi-cloud backup pipeline that transfers files from AWS S3 to Google Cloud Storage using GCP's Storage Transfer Service and identity federation.

articles.title: Private Cloud Home Lab (Part 1: Hardware Setup & Proxmox Installation)
articles.description: A step-by-step guide on how to assemble the hardware and converting a Mini PC into a bare-metal Proxmox VE hypervisor as the foundation for a self-hosted private cloud.

articles.title: Private Cloud Home Lab (Part 2: Creating a NextcloudPi LXC Container)
articles.description: A walkthrough on how to provision a NextcloudPi LXC container on Proxmox VE, covering Ubuntu template download, secure unprivileged container configuration, and automated installation using the Proxmox VE Helper Scripts community installer.

articles.title: Private Cloud Home Lab (Part 3: Setting Up a Containerized Nextcloud Instance with Docker)
articles.description: A thorough guide on how to install Docker on an Ubuntu Server LXC container and deploy a Nextcloud instance backed by MariaDB using Docker Compose

articles.title: Private Cloud Home Lab (Part 4: Securing Nextcloud with Tailscale VPN and Access Control)
articles.description: A walkthrough on how to secure remote access to a self-hosted Nextcloud instance by integrating Tailscale, enforcing tag-based ACL policies to restrict inter-device traffic, and preparing least-privilege AWS IAM credentials for the upcoming S3 backup in Part 5.

articles.title: Private Cloud Home Lab (Part 5: On-Premises and AWS Storage Backup)
articles.description: A step-by-step walkthrough on how to set up a fully automated dual-layer backup system for a self-hosted Nextcloud instance, mirroring data nightly to both a locally-mounted external SSD and an AWS S3 bucket using a Bash script scheduled via cron.

articles.title: Home Lab Security (Part 1: Network Isolation with OPNsense Firewall)
articles.description: A walkthrough on segmenting a home network with OPNsense firewall, isolating the LAN with alias-driven rules and an implicit deny.

articles.title: Home Lab Security (Part 2: Hardening Remote Access with Tailscale)
articles.description: A thorough guide on tightening Tailscale access controls after a network migration annd approving route to the local LAN net.

articles.title: Home Lab Security (Part 3: Deploying Wazuh & Detecting Attacks on Nextcloud)
articles.description: A document diving into deploying Wazuh as a SIEM for Nextcloud, and building detection rules with MITRE ATT&CK tagging.

articles.title: Home Lab Security (Part 4: Automated Email Alerting)
articles.description: A walkthrough of wiring Wazuh detection rules up to real email alerts on severe logs via a Postfix relay to prevent alert fatigue.
